suites.title: The Royal Imperial Penthouse
suites.tagline: 450 m² • 360° Ocean Vista • Private Plunge Pool & Helipad Pier
features: Private heated cliffside infinity plunge pool
24/7 Dedicated Royal Butler & Private Chef
Hermès Paris bespoke bath amenities
Temperature-controlled sommelier wine cellar

suites.description: Suspended between azure sea and open sky, the Royal Imperial Penthouse commands the entire crown floor. Sculpted marble floors, private sunset sundeck, dual master wings, and unconditional white-glove butler service create the pinnacle of private Mediterranean sanctuary.

suites.title: The Platinum Ocean Suite
suites.tagline: 280 m² • Wraparound Teak Terrace • Carved Marble Soaking Spa

Custom hand-stitched silk and velvet bedding
Direct elevator connection to Thalasso Spa
Complimentary Dom Pérignon vintage on arrival
Italian walnut dressing parlor with bespoke vanity
suites.description: Embodying classic Riviera glamour with contemporary architectural quietude, the Platinum Ocean Suite surrounds you with warm walnut millwork, handcrafted furnishings, and gentle ocean breezes across an expansive private terrace.

suites.title: The Azure Lagoon Villa
suites.tagline: 320 m² • Direct Overwater Access • Secluded Tropical Garden

Outdoor rain grotto shower amidst exotic palms
Crystal glass floor observation panel
Nightly private sunset dinner setup on the pier
In-villa signature spa massages by appointment
suites.description: Tucked along our private crystalline cove, the Azure Lagoon Villa provides absolute seclusion. Step directly from your private infinity sundeck into the sparkling waters, surrounded by lush native botanical gardens and whispering palms.

suites.title: Grand Horizon Suite
suites.tagline: 190 m² • Floor-to-Ceiling Glass • Private Sunset Firepit

Artisan espresso & private cocktail bar
Rainfall wet room with heated limestone benches
Evening starlight turndown & aromatherapy selection
Complimentary chauffeured Rolls-Royce transfers
suites.description: Watch the sun dissolve into the Mediterranean from your private cliffside lounge. Featuring open-concept spatial proportions, state-of-the-art smart environmental controls, and unmatched serenity.
